violation_type.title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have documentation available at the time of inspection showing smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors were tested. This was corrected at inspection when the director tested all detectors and documented on the form.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have documentation available at the time of inspection showing smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors were tested. This was corrected at inspection when the director tested all detectors and documented on the form.
Operation did not have monthly carbon monoxide checks documented.

Operation did not have documented the test, date of installation of new batteries, and the name of the employee who does the testing and installment of new batteries. This was corrected at inspection.
While reviewing records there was no documentation of monthly test being conducted. This was corrected at the inspection when test were conducted and documented.
Operation did not have a carbon monoxide checklist for CCR to view. The child's record did not have an admission form.

The operation had not recorded monthly carbon monoxide detector testing for January and February.    NOTE:  The assistant director was able to reference past calendar dates and enter the dates the units were tested during the inspection.
